原: Today we have a very interesting guest, mr. / Thomas Benjamin Grimm, the mayor of Berkton, …
疑为: Today we have a very interesting guest, Mr. Thomas Benjamin Grimm, the mayor of Berkton, …
理由: 在 Mr. 的句点处被切成两句，句首 mr. 小写；45、46 应为一句

原: mr. / Grimm, thank you for being here.
疑为: Mr. Grimm, thank you for being here.
理由: 同上，在 Mr. 处切断；47、48 应为一句
动议编号被句点切开（第 76 句题目写作 “Motion 836”）；60、61 应为一句
第 94 句为 John A. Rogers，同一人，漏了 s；译为“罗杰斯”

原: According to a study that came out in March. / Elite sleepers have rare genetic changes, …
疑为: According to a study that came out in March, elite sleepers have rare genetic changes, …
理由: 状语从句被句点切断；109、110 应为一句

原: … each with. / Several pages long, and either presented …
疑为: … each several pages long, which either presented …
理由: 一句从中间被句点切断，each with 疑为口误或转写错误；131、132 应为一句

原: Even as motherhood rates decline, Mother’s Day, of course. / Endure.
疑为: Even as motherhood rates decline, Mother’s Day will, of course, endure.
理由: 一句被切成两句，疑漏了 will；164、165 应为一句

原: Since NASA published a paper in 1989 claiming that house plants can soak up pollution and toxic chemicals. / Businesses and homeowners have increasingly invested …
疑为: Since NASA published a paper in 1989 claiming …, businesses and homeowners have increasingly invested …
理由: Since 从句与主句被句点切开；174、175 应为一句
